events.text: Murphy was awarded the Medal of Honor for his actions that day.
events.subject: self
events.quote: For his actions that day , he was awarded the Medal of Honor .

events.text: Murphy was promoted to first lieutenant.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 16 February , Murphy was promoted to first lieutenant

events.text: Murphy was awarded the Legion of Merit for his service from 22 January 1944.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was awarded the Legion of Merit for his service from 22 January 1944

events.text: Murphy's service for the Legion of Merit ended 18 February 1945.
events.subject: self

events.text: Murphy was moved from the front lines to Regimental Headquarters and made a liaison officer.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was moved from the front lines to Regimental Headquarters and made a liaison officer .
